preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: s consists of only capital English letters M and F
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only the characters M and F.

postconditions.description: The output is 0 if the input string s contains only boys or only girls.
The output is a positive integer representing the number of seconds needed to move all girls in front of boys.
